maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is advertising sold on radio stations, podcasts and digital, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Advertisers, private businesses buying radio, podcast and digital ads, pay for it; listeners get it free.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from its own radio, podcast and digital audience and ad sales, not a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can shift ad budgets to other radio, streaming or media sellers easily; advertising is easily substituted.
